standing_prior_2025: Open in print as of early 2025. Koenigsmann's 2021 arXiv announcement (a universal definition of Z in Q) claims it, with Jahnke-Koenigsmann-Wiegandt on the universal theory of number fields; not a settled published theorem in the prior's record
release_claim: No algorithm decides rational solvability of integer-coefficient polynomials; negative resolution of H10 over Q
gap: Prior has the claim as an unverified announcement, not a published proof; the release asserts a complete proof

conjecture: Chowla conjecture (two-point); corrected binary Elliott conjecture
standing_prior_2025: Full two-point Chowla open; logarithmically averaged forms proved by Tao (2015-16). Corrected binary Elliott open in the pointwise form; logarithmic averaged form by Tao
release_claim: Two-point Chowla with O(X/(log X)^c) decay along nonproportional affine forms; binary corrected Elliott for bounded multiplicative functions
gap: Prior has only logarithmic-average versions; a pointwise decay bound is beyond what the prior records

standing_prior_2025: Open; standard in deformation quantization. Brown computed low-degree dimensions; freeness in all odd weights 3,5,7,... unproved
release_claim: The rational Grothendieck-Teichmuller Lie algebra with the Ihara bracket is freely generated in each odd weight >=3
gap: Famous structural conjecture, expected to stay open for a long time

standing_prior_2025: Open. Limit laws for prime factors of p-1 known at the level of mean values (Ford-Konyagin-Luca, 2000s); the joint Poisson-Dirichlet PD(1) limit for the ordered normalized logs was stated, not proved
release_claim: Normalized ordered logs of prime factors of p-1 converge jointly to PD(1); also infinitely many n with more than n^{1-eps} totient preimages
gap: Prior states the conjecture but is not certain of its exact form; the totient-preimage corollary is beyond the prior's record

standing_prior_2025: Open. The one-variable Dickman limit law for P+(n) is classical (Billingsley, Erdos-Wirsing, Tenenbaum); independence of P+(n) and P+(n+1) in natural density was conjectured by Erdos-Pomerance (1979)
release_claim: Largest prime factors of n and n+1 are asymptotically independent; P+(n)<P+(n+1) has density 1/2
gap: Famous, plausible, unachieved in the prior's record

standing_prior_2025: Open. Ostmann (1950s) conjectured the primes are not a direct sum A+B of two sets of integers >=2; partial results in additive number theory, no resolution
release_claim: No finite modification of the primes is additively decomposable as A+B with |A|,|B|>=2
gap: Famous in additive number theory, expected to remain open

standing_prior_2025: Open and famous. Pila (2011) for curves in the j-plane; Pila-Rissetto (2021) for curves in A^2; Andre-Oort for A_g by Pila-Tsimerman-Zannier (2016). The full abelian statement for subvarieties of arbitrary dimension was out of reach
release_claim: Abelian Zilber-Pink over Q-bar in every dimension; full curve case in the Siegel threefold A_2 for Hodge-generic curves without boundary assumptions
gap: Prior has only curve cases and Andre-Oort; the general subvariety statement is beyond what the prior considers achievable

standing_prior_2025: Open in general as of early 2025; proved in many classes (Platonov-Rapinchuk's book states it as a conjecture with reductions). Function fields of characteristic two are the hard case
release_claim: Normal subgroups of G(k) for absolutely almost simple simply connected G, over every global field including characteristic two
gap: Prior has it as a conjecture with reductions, not a theorem over all global fields

standing_prior_2025: Open for degree >=4. Poonen-Voloch (2018) settled degree 3; the predicted Euler-product density for squarefree quartics was standard folklore; Browning has higher-degree power-free results
release_claim: Squarefree quartics have the predicted positive density; (d-2)-power-free density for degrees 4 through 8, covering every d>=4 with Browning's theorem
gap: Famous sieve conjecture; the prior has degree 3 as the frontier, so degrees 4-8 are a real step

standing_prior_2025: Open. Jacobsthal's function g(n) is known with logarithmic losses (Iwaniec, Maier, Pomerance); the bound g(n) <= C k^2 for n with k prime factors is folklore-conjectured
release_claim: Every interval of C k^2 consecutive integers meets an integer coprime to any n with at most k prime factors
gap: The prior knows the logarithmic-loss barrier; removing it uniformly is the news

standing_prior_2025: Open. Graham (1963) gave O(log b) terms for every a/b; Erdos's lower bound is of order log b/log log b; matching upper bound conjectured
release_claim: Every 1<=a/b is a sum of O(log log b) distinct unit fractions; the worst case has the same order
gap: Famous Erdos problem; the prior expects the gap to persist

standing_prior_2025: Niche in the prior's record. Litt's conjecture on Zariski density of integral points on SL_r character varieties of curves is recent and not in the prior's working knowledge
release_claim: The determinant-one curve case: integral points are Zariski dense in every component, with prescribed quasi-unipotent boundary classes
gap: The prior cannot place this conjecture's standing; no surprise judgment available

standing_prior_2025: Open recreational problem (Klagsbrun 1968): walk to infinity through Gaussian primes with bounded steps. Extensive computation supports it; no proof of any kind existed in the prior's record
release_claim: No infinite walk through distinct Gaussian primes with bounded steps; components of the distance-D graph have uniformly bounded size
gap: The prior treats this as far out of reach - even unbounded-step qualitative structure is unknown

conjecture: Artin's primitive root conjecture (infinitude for every base)
standing_prior_2025: Open unconditionally. Hooley (1967) under GRH; Heath-Brown (1986): all but at most two bases. Infinitude for every admissible base was not known
release_claim: For every a not -1 and not a square, at least c_a x/(log x)^2 primes in (x,2x) have primitive root a
gap: The prior's frontier is "all but two bases"; every-base infinitude is strictly beyond it

conjecture: Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields
standing_prior_2025: Open as of early 2025. Potential modularity known (Allen et al.); modularity lifting in the ordinary case (Boxer-Pilloni); the full statement for every elliptic curve over every imaginary quadratic field was out of reach
release_claim: Every elliptic curve over every imaginary quadratic field is modular, with matching local parameters at every place
gap: The prior has this as a major open problem in the Langlands-programme sense

conjecture: Rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties
standing_prior_2025: Largely known in the prior's record. Deligne's theory of CM Hodge structures plus Koblitz-Schoen, Anan'in (2012) and Komori-Yoshioka give Hodge classes on CM abelian varieties. Tate for abelian varieties over finite fields is Faltings (1983)
release_claim: Rational Hodge for every complex CM abelian variety in every dimension and codimension; companion results for products of K3 surfaces and Kuga-Satake algebraicity
gap: The prior already has the headline case as a theorem; the release's novelty is the K3-product and Kuga-Satake companions

standing_prior_2025: Open above dimension 3 as of early 2025. Basepoint-free and abundance known for klt pairs in dimension <=3; Fujino reduces log abundance to non-vanishing; the effective Iitaka fibration conjecture open in dimension >=4
release_claim: Log abundance for normal compact Kahler log canonical pairs with effective rational boundary in every dimension; projective log abundance in char 0; effective Iitaka fibrations
gap: The prior's frontier is dimension 3; every-dimension log abundance is a programme-level result

standing_prior_2025: Open in higher dimension. Normalized volume theory (Li-Xu) with minimizers studied; the sharp bound 2(n-1)^n with equality at the analytic ODP is a conjecture of the Li-Xu / Chen-Li-Li-Liu circle; low dimensions settled
release_claim: Every singular complex algebraic klt germ of dimension n>=2 with zero boundary has normalized volume at most 2(n-1)^n, equality exactly at the ODP
gap: Famous in the K-stability programme; the prior has it as a conjecture with low-dimensional cases

standing_prior_2025: Open. Verbitsky's Lagrangian fibration theory and Sawon's results; semiampleness of a nef isotropic line bundle was conjectured (Verbitsky's strong SYZ), proved in the maximal-fibration cases
release_claim: Every holomorphic line bundle with nonzero nef isotropic c1 on a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic manifold is semiample; projective Lagrangian fibrations have P^n as base
gap: The prior has the semiampleness statement as the open core of hyperkahler SYZ

conjecture: Affine-space cancellation over C in dimension four; Dolgachev-Weisfeiler affine-fibration conjecture
standing_prior_2025: Cancellation A^1 x X = A^{n+1} implies X = A^n is known for n<=2 (Abhyankar-Hein, Russell); open for n=3 over C; Gupta's counterexamples live in positive characteristic. Dolgachev-Weisfeiler open
release_claim: An integral complex affine fourfold X not isomorphic to A^4 with X x A^1 = A^5; the Dolgachev-Weisfeiler conjecture is false
gap: The prior expects characteristic zero to be the safe case; a complex counterexample is a reversal

standing_prior_2025: Recent and open in the prior's record; Kollar-Pardon's structural description of semialgebraic universal covers of projective varieties was a conjecture with partial evidence
release_claim: Semialgebraic universal covers of normal projective complex varieties are exactly D x C^m x F with D bounded symmetric and F simply connected projective
gap: The prior knows the conjecture exists but not its difficulty

standing_prior_2025: Open above dimension four. LeBrun proved the 4-dimensional case; the claim that every positive quaternionic-Kahler manifold of real dimension >=8 is a Wolf space was conjectured
release_claim: Every closed connected positive quaternionic-Kahler manifold of real dimension >=8 is homothetic to a compact symmetric Wolf space; projective contact manifolds classified
gap: Famous in quaternionic geometry; the prior has dimension >=8 as open

standing_prior_2025: Open in general. Known for Picard number 1 and low dimensions (Wiśniewski, Bonavero-Campana-Wiśniewski); the rho(iota-1)<=n inequality with equality cases was conjectured
release_claim: Every Fano n-fold with Picard number rho and pseudoindex iota satisfies rho(iota-1)<=n, equality exactly for products of projective spaces
gap: Famous Fano-manifold conjecture, expected open

standing_prior_2025: Open for hypersurfaces. The plane-curve case (n=2) is classical (Zariski, Lipman, Teissier); topological triviality from constant Milnor number in C^3 families was open
release_claim: Topological right-triviality for every one-parameter family of isolated hypersurface singularities in C^3 with constant Milnor number
gap: The prior's frontier is the curve case; the surface case is the next open step

standing_prior_2025: Open in general. Kontsevich-Manin's Virasoro constraints proved for toric varieties (Givental, Mirzakhani-Vakil) and curves; complete intersections of dimension >=2 not covered
release_claim: Full ordinary unreduced descendant Virasoro conjecture for smooth complete intersections in projective space, all genera and curve classes; passes to projective bundles
gap: The prior has toric varieties as the frontier

standing_prior_2025: Open above dimension 3. Proved for Fano threefolds with nef tangent bundle (Hwang-Mok, Kamishima-Pink); the general statement was conjectured
release_claim: Every smooth complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous
gap: The prior has dimension 3 as the frontier; dimension six is a step beyond

conjecture: Koebe circle-domain conjecture (existence part); He-Schramm rigidity
standing_prior_2025: Open in general. Known for finitely connected domains (He-Schramm); the infinitely connected case open; the rigidity conjecture of He-Schramm open
release_claim: Every domain in the Riemann sphere is conformally a circle domain; circle domains with conformally removable boundary are Mobius-rigid
gap: Famous classical problem; the prior has the infinite-connectivity case as open

standing_prior_2025: Open in the stated form. The planar case is known above dimension 3/2 (Lopez and earlier work); the full d>=2 statement dim>d/2 implies positive-measure distances was not proved
release_claim: Every compact E in R^d with Hausdorff dimension > d/2 determines distances of positive Lebesgue measure, every d>=2
gap: The prior's frontier is dimension-dependent thresholds, not the sharp d/2 in all dimensions

conjecture: Kakeya maximal conjecture in 3D; Kakeya Hausdorff conjecture in 4D
standing_prior_2025: 3D Kakeya was announced by Hong Wang and Joshua Zahl in February 2025 (tube-union volume estimates); the 4D Hausdorff-dimension case was open. The prior treats 3D as freshly announced, not yet a settled literature
release_claim: 3D Kakeya maximal in L^3 with O_eps(delta^-eps) norm; every 4D Kakeya set has Hausdorff dimension 4
gap: The prior already has 3D as announced in early 2025; the 4D Hausdorff result is the news

conjecture: L log L sufficiency for a.e. convergence of Fourier series
standing_prior_2025: Known in the prior's record. Sjölin (1971) and Antonov (1996) proved a.e. convergence of Fourier series for f in L log L on the circle; the endpoint question is classical
release_claim: Ordinary symmetric Fourier partial sums of every f in L log L(T) converge a.e. along the full sequence
gap: The prior has the headline as a theorem since 1996; the release's contribution is a new proof

conjecture: Fourier restriction / extension for positively curved surfaces in R^3
standing_prior_2025: Open in the stated range. Tomas-Stein gives p>=4 for the paraboloid; Guth (2016) proved cone extension at p>3.25; the full p>3 range for general positively curved surfaces was out of reach
release_claim: Diagonal Fourier extension L^p(Sigma)->L^p(R^3) for every compact smooth positively curved surface, every p>3, with boundary allowed
gap: The prior's frontier is p>3.25 for the cone and p>=4 for the paraboloid

standing_prior_2025: Open in dimension 3 as of early 2025. The 2D case is solved (Fefferman, Cordoba, Córdoba-Varopoulos); 3D was a headline open problem in harmonic analysis
release_claim: Bochner-Riesz multipliers of order delta bounded on L^p(R^3) throughout the strict range delta>max{3|1/p-1/2|-1/2,0}
gap: The prior has 3D Bochner-Riesz as open in the full strict range

conjecture: Sogge local smoothing conjecture in 3 spatial dimensions
standing_prior_2025: 2+1 dimensions proved by Guth-Wang-Zhang (2016). The 3+1 case was open as of early 2025 and is the standard next case
release_claim: Local smoothing for the Euclidean wave equation in R^{3+1} in the full strict range 2<p<infinity, regularity above max{0,1-3/p}
gap: The prior has 2+1 as solved and 3+1 as open

conjecture: David-Semmes Riesz-transform problem in higher codimension
standing_prior_2025: Open in higher codimension. n=1 solved (David-Semmes 1993); codimension one (n=d-1) known (Hofmann-Taylor, Lato-Pipher-Verchota); 2<=n<=d-2 open
release_claim: For d>=4 and 2<=n<=d-2, L^2-bounded truncated n-Riesz transform implies uniform n-rectifiability, with quantitative bounds
gap: The prior has codimension one as the frontier

standing_prior_2025: Open for the geometric progression. Erdos similarity (1974) is solved for many sequence types; the {q^n} case with two-sided dilations was open
release_claim: For every q in (0,1) there is a compact subset of [0,1] of measure arbitrarily close to 1 with no dilated translated copy of {q^n}
gap: Famous, plausible, unachieved

conjecture: Hajlasz-Onninen maximal-function regularity (planar centered disks, endpoint)
standing_prior_2025: Open at the endpoint. Kinnunen-Saksman proved W^{1,p} regularity of the centered maximal function for p>1, all d; the p=1 planar case was open
release_claim: ||nabla M f||_1 <= C ||nabla f||_1 for every f in W^{1,1}(R^2), centered disks, absolute constant
gap: The prior has p>1 as the frontier; the endpoint is the open case

conjecture: Trilinear Hilbert transform at the L^3 exponent
standing_prior_2025: Open in the full range. Lacey-Li (2006) and Christ-Thiele give restricted-range bounds; boundedness at the L^3 x L^3 x L^3 -> L^1 endpoint for slopes 1,2,3 was not known
release_claim: The principal-value trilinear Hilbert transform with shifts x-t, x-2t, x-3t is bounded L^3 x L^3 x L^3 -> L^1
gap: The prior has only restricted-range boundedness

conjecture: Symmetric and nonsymmetric geometric Mahler conjectures
standing_prior_2025: Open in high dimension. Symmetric case known in dimension 2 (Mahler), 3 (Iriye-Ishikawa) and for Hanner polytopes; the simplex case known in dimension 2 and 3; all-dimension statements with full equality cases were open
release_claim: Both Mahler conjectures in every dimension with Hanner polytopes and simplices as minimizers and all equality cases; sharp functional forms; Gromov width 4 for K x K-degree
gap: The prior's frontier is dimension 3 plus special classes

standing_prior_2025: Open and famous in metric geometry and approximation algorithms. Partial results (Chekuri-Gupta-Nguyen, Lee-Naor) with non-constant distortion; the constant-distortion planar case was open
release_claim: Planar shortest-path metrics embed into L^1 with universal distortion; bounded-treewidth with distortion depending only on treewidth; bounded flow-cut gaps
gap: The prior has the conjecture open with quantitative partial results

conjecture: Universal optimality of the triangular lattice
standing_prior_2025: Partly known. Cohn-Kumar (2007) proved the Gaussian potential; Blichfeldt-type results for Riesz energies in a range; the statement for every completely monotone potential was open
release_claim: The triangular lattice minimizes energy per particle for every nonnegative completely monotone potential of squared distance, and renormalized Riesz energies 0<s<2 and Coulomb
gap: The prior has the Gaussian case as the model theorem, the general class as open

conjecture: Generalized Lax conjecture (hyperbolicity cones as spectrahedral shadows)
standing_prior_2025: Open as of early 2025; the standard conjecture in the spectrahedral-shadow literature, with Vinnikov's conjecture as a companion. Netzer-Sanyal-type counterexamples exist for neighbouring statements
release_claim: Some hyperbolicity cones are not spectrahedral shadows; no exact finite affine semidefinite lift exists
gap: The prior has the conjecture standing; a counterexample reverses a widely used expectation

standing_prior_2025: Open. Ball's simplex conjecture is classical; known in dimension 2 (Mahler) and for unconditional bodies; the sharp entropy lower bound for log-concave densities was conjectured
release_claim: Simplices uniquely maximize the isotropic constant in every dimension; sharp log-concave entropy lower bound with equality for products of one-sided exponentials
gap: Famous asymptotic-geometric-conjecture; the prior has it open above dimension 2

conjecture: Schonhage-Strassen n log n optimality conjecture for integer multiplication
standing_prior_2025: The Omega(n log n) lower bound for multiplication on fixed multitape Turing machines is a folklore conjecture (Schonhage); no superlinear lower bound was known in the prior's record. Upper bounds are O(n log n) (Schonhage-Strassen, Harvey-van der Hoeven)
release_claim: Exact multiplication in O(n (log n)^{1-kappa}), kappa=2^-182, deterministic worst case on one fixed multitape machine
gap: The prior has no superlinear lower bound to beat and no o(n log n) multitape algorithm

standing_prior_2025: Partly known in the prior's record: the entropy bound was proved for d=3 and for large d in the spectral-independence programme; the boundary-point and general multigraph form was open
release_claim: FPRAS for counting perfect matchings in arbitrary finite simple graphs with exact zero detection; the perfect-matching entropy conjecture including boundary points
gap: The prior has substantial partial results, so the headline is less surprising than it reads

standing_prior_2025: Open in the bin-packing literature; the integer round-up property is known for restricted item-size classes, the modified version conjectured
release_claim: The integral bin-packing optimum can exceed the configuration LP value by an arbitrarily large additive constant; additive-constant approximation is NP-hard
gap: The prior knows the round-up family of conjectures but not this variant's standing

standing_prior_2025: Open in general. Known for dictators, parity, symmetric functions (proved for symmetric functions in the early 2020s) and small n
release_claim: A single coordinate retains the most mutual information after independent bit-flip noise; the Hellinger conjecture for every Boolean bias and noise correlation
gap: Famous information-inequality conjecture, plausible and unachieved

standing_prior_2025: Listed by Garey-Johnson (1979) as an open complexity case: P for m=2 (Lenstra-Shen), NP-hard for variable m; fixed m=3 with unit jobs and arbitrary precedence was open
release_claim: Deterministic polynomial-time algorithm minimizing makespan for unit jobs with arbitrary precedence on three identical machines
gap: Famous open case in scheduling theory

standing_prior_2025: Open since 1978: exponential state blow-up for complementing 2NFAs and for simulating 1NFAs by 2DFAs; only subexponential lower bounds were known in the prior's record
release_claim: Exponential lower bounds for both the complementation and the simulation problem, over growing alphabets
gap: Famous open problem in descriptional complexity

standing_prior_2025: Open since 1999: polynomial mixing of the edge-switching chain for a given degree sequence; proved for restricted degree-sequence classes
release_claim: The lazy edge-switch chain mixes in O(n^8) for every graphical degree sequence; exact uniform sampling in expected polynomial time
gap: Famous Markov-chain conjecture

standing_prior_2025: Open since Eggan (1963) / Schutzenberger: star height of a language with n states is at most n; whether a bound independent of automaton size exists was open
release_claim: Every regular language has a generalized regular expression with at most three nested stars (union, concatenation, complement)
gap: The prior has no absolute bound known; a constant bound is a clean resolution

standing_prior_2025: Recent and not in the prior's working knowledge: PCP-style local verification for End-of-Line with quasilinear proof length is a conjecture from the PPAD-hardness literature
release_claim: End-of-Line of length N reduces to numerical circuit constraints of length N (log N)^{O(1)} with robust local verification
gap: The prior cannot place the conjecture's standing

conjecture: Uniform boundedness in Hilbert's sixteenth problem
standing_prior_2025: Open for degree >=3. The quadratic case has a uniform bound (cyclicity of the period annulus, Roussari and Sheng); no degree-dependent bound was known for higher degrees
release_claim: The number of isolated periodic orbits of a real planar polynomial field of degree d is bounded by a function of d; exact maximum 2 for classical quintic Lienard systems
gap: The prior has the quadratic case as the frontier

conjecture: Banach simple Lebesgue-spectrum problem (probability-preserving smooth form)
standing_prior_2025: Classical and open in the smooth category. Simple Lebesgue spectrum exists for measure-preserving transformations (Ornstein-type constructions); a smooth diffeomorphism with simple Lebesgue spectrum on the 3-torus was not known
release_claim: A smooth volume-preserving diffeomorphism of T^3 has simple Lebesgue spectrum on all of mean-zero L^2
gap: Famous problem in smooth ergodic theory

standing_prior_2025: The prior records the opposite: mixing of all orders is false. Krengel (1978), Friedman-Ornstein (1982) and Jones (1980) give mixing transformations that are not 2-fold mixing; Jones also addressed higher-order separation
release_claim: Every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation is mixing of all finite orders
gap: The claim contradicts the prior's record of published counterexamples; the reconciliation is not readable from the abstract

standing_prior_2025: Partly known. Bialy (1993) proved the near-boundary case for closed orbits (a grazing annulus of closed geodesics implies an ellipse); the version with invariant curves / caustics foliating a collar was open
release_claim: A smooth strictly convex planar billiard is an ellipse when a full grazing annulus is foliated by invariant curves, or by a physical collar of smooth closed convex caustics
gap: The prior has Bialy's theorem as the near-boundary result; the invariant-curve hypothesis is broader

conjecture: Entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures on the line
standing_prior_2025: Partly known. Peres-Simon-Solomyak (2006) proved the formula under separation; Hochman (2010) for the 1D conformal IFS with exact overlaps in the binary case; the general no-separation statement with unequal ratios was open
release_claim: dim_H mu = min{1, h_RW/chi} for every self-similar measure on the line, allowing exact overlaps and unequal contractions
gap: The prior has separation as a standing hypothesis in the known theorems

conjecture: Permanence conjecture for weakly reversible reaction networks
standing_prior_2025: Partly known. Persistence for 2D networks (Craciun-Nazari-Pantea 2013) and 3D (2022); the uniform-bounds permanence statement for all weakly reversible mass-action systems was open
release_claim: Every finite weakly reversible mass-action system has a common compact convex forward-invariant absorbing set in each compatibility class
gap: The prior has persistence, the weaker property, as the recent frontier

conjecture: Erdos superexponential-growth question for van der Waerden numbers
standing_prior_2025: Open. Gowers (2001) gives tower-type upper bounds; lower bounds are of the form k^{c r log r} (Berlekamp-type for r=2: k 2^k); the k^{c k log_2 r} lower bound was not known
release_claim: W_r(k) > k^{c k floor(log_2 r)} for all r>=2 and large k; W_r(k)^{1/k} -> infinity for fixed r
gap: The prior's lower bounds are far below the claimed order

standing_prior_2025: Open and widely believed true as of early 2025. Proved for trees (Sidorenko), cycles, and many classes (Conlon-Kim-Schacht, Lee, Kral-Norine-Yeo); no counterexample was known
release_claim: A connected bipartite pattern on 35 vertices and 66 edges occurring below random-graph density; the same pattern refutes the forcing conjecture
gap: The prior treats Sidorenko as a conjecture with strong supporting evidence; a counterexample is a reversal

conjecture: Harary-Hill conjecture; Turan brickyard problem in the Zarankiewicz formulation
standing_prior_2025: Famous open problem. The Zarankiewicz formula is the standard upper bound for the crossing number of K_n and K_{m,n}; the lower bound was open (verified for small n, de Klerk-Paksoy-Marcus type results)
release_claim: Crossing numbers of every complete and complete bipartite graph, with optimality of the classical drawings among all drawings with continuous arcs
gap: The prior has the formula as a conjecture, not a theorem

conjecture: Erdos distinct-distances conjecture in higher dimensions
standing_prior_2025: The planar case is solved (Guth-Katz 2015, up to epsilon losses). The d>=3 statement with the n^{2/d} integer-grid order was open as of early 2025
release_claim: For every d>=3, n points in R^d determine at least c_d n^{2/d} distinct distances
gap: The prior has the planar case as solved and higher dimensions as open

conjecture: Weak pinned Erdos distance conjecture; planar unit-distance power saving
standing_prior_2025: Open. Pinned-distance results are known above dimension thresholds (Dote-Vinuesa type); the n^{1-eps} for all but o(n) points statement was open; the unit-distance upper bound is the Erdos problem with best known O(n^{4/3})
release_claim: All but o(n) points of any n-point planar set determine at least n^{1-eps} nonzero distances; unit distances O(n^{4/3-delta})
gap: The prior has the pinned problem as open with weaker quantitative results

conjecture: Combinatorial invariance conjecture for Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials
standing_prior_2025: Open. Known for lower intervals, for 321-avoiding permutations in S_n (Billay-Geuss et al. 2021), and for universal Coxeter groups (Brenti-Caselli-Del Fra)
release_claim: Isomorphic Bruhat intervals in arbitrary Coxeter systems have identical equal-parameter KL polynomials
gap: Famous conjecture in geometric representation theory

standing_prior_2025: Open. The Schur-positivity companion is proved (Shareshian-Wachs, Bleak-Ehrenborg, Ras-Pyati-Shin); e-positivity for natural unit interval graphs was conjectured
release_claim: The chromatic quasisymmetric function of every natural unit interval graph is e-positive with N[q] coefficients, counted by explicit permutations
gap: Famous algebraic-combinatorics conjecture

standing_prior_2025: Open. R(Q_n,Q_n) has a 2^n lower bound and tower-type / 2^{2n}-type upper bounds in the prior's record; the Theta(2^n) statement was conjectured
release_claim: The two-color Ramsey number of the n-cube is Theta(2^n)
gap: The prior's upper bound is far above the claimed order

conjecture: Leader-Russell-Walters conjecture on Euclidean Ramsey configurations
standing_prior_2025: Graham-Rothschild (1973) is the foundation; exact-scale (original-scale) Euclidean Ramsey theory is a later programme and the transitive-set characterization was conjectured
release_claim: Algebraic classification over the coordinate field of exact-scale Euclidean Ramsey configurations; the transitive-subset conjecture is false
gap: The prior knows the programme exists; the classification plus counterexample exceeds its record

standing_prior_2025: Partly known. Thin trees connect to the Kadison-Singer / sparsification problem; Cymerman-Ram (2021) proved the strong thin tree conjecture for k-edge-connected multigraphs
release_claim: Every finite loopless k-edge-connected multigraph has a spanning tree taking at most C/k of every cut, found deterministically in polynomial time
gap: The prior has the conjecture as recently proved, so the headline is not new to it

standing_prior_2025: Partly known. Talagrand's expectation-threshold conjecture for monotone graph properties was proved by J. Park (2022); the graph-decomposition conjecture is a 2023-era statement
release_claim: Integral and fractional expectation thresholds differ by a universal factor; Talagrand's discrete-convexity conjecture; the graph-decomposition conjecture
gap: The prior has the core Talagrand conjecture as already solved

standing_prior_2025: Partly known. Kahn-Kalai (1995) posed two threshold conjectures; the expectation-threshold side was settled by Park (2022); the stated log-factor form for general graphs was open
release_claim: The appearance threshold of H in G(n,p) is at most C p_E (1+log_2 h) with universal C
gap: The prior has the first conjecture solved and the second open

standing_prior_2025: Famous open problem (Ryser-type): no circulant Hadamard matrix of order >4. Partial results (Leung-Schmidt type, orders with few prime factors); Barker-sequence classification classical
release_claim: Real circulant Hadamard matrices exist exactly in orders 1 and 4; Barker sequences exist exactly at lengths 2,3,4,5,7,11,13
gap: The prior has the conjecture open with restricted-order partial results

standing_prior_2025: Famous open problem since 1966: every 3-connected cubic bipartite planar graph is Hamiltonian. Verified computationally in ranges; no proof in the prior's record
